subject: Biology
notes: The document has no learning-outcomes column for Biology, so chapter outcomes are left empty.
Digestion and Absorption is included but assessed only formatively (see CBSE Reading Material).

chapters.name: The Living World
topics: concept of species and taxonomical hierarchy

chapters.name: Biological Classification
topics: salient features and classification of Monera, Protista and Fungi into major groups

chapters.name: Plant Kingdom
topics: Classification of plants into major groups
salient and distinguishing features and examples of Algae, Bryophyta, Pteridophyta, Gymnospermae and Angiosperms

chapters.name: Animal Kingdom
topics: Salient features and classification of animals
non-chordates up to phyla level and chordates up to class level, with examples
notes: No live animals or specimens should be displayed

units.name: Structural Organization in Plants and Animals

chapters.name: Morphology of Flowering Plants
topics: Morphology of root, stem, leaf, inflorescence, flower, fruit and seed

chapters.name: Anatomy of Flowering Plants
topics: Anatomy and functions of tissue systems in dicots and monocots

chapters.name: Structural Organisation in Animals
topics: Morphology, anatomy and functions of the digestive, circulatory, respiratory, nervous and reproductive systems of the frog

chapters.name: Cell: The Unit of Life
topics: Cell theory and cell as the basic unit of life
structure of prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells
cell envelope, cell membrane, cell wall
endomembrane system: endoplasmic reticulum, golgi bodies, lysosomes, vacuoles
cytoskeleton, cilia, flagella, centrioles (ultrastructure and function)

chapters.name: Biomolecules
topics: structure and function of proteins, carbohydrates, lipids and nucleic acids
notes: Excluded: nature of bond linking monomers in a polymer, dynamic state of body constituents, concept of metabolism, metabolic basis of living, the living state

chapters.name: Respiration in Plants
topics: cellular respiration: glycolysis, fermentation (anaerobic), TCA cycle and electron transport system (aerobic)
energy relations: number of ATP molecules generated

chapters.name: Plant Growth and Development
topics: phases of plant growth and plant growth rate
sequence of developmental processes in a plant cell
plant growth regulators: auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, ethylene, ABA

chapters.name: Breathing and Exchange of Gases
topics: mechanism of breathing and its regulation: exchange and transport of gases, regulation of respiration, respiratory volume
disorders: asthma, emphysema, occupational respiratory disorders

chapters.name: Body Fluids and Circulation
topics: Composition of blood, blood groups, coagulation
human circulatory system: structure of heart and blood vessels
disorders: hypertension, coronary artery disease, angina pectoris, heart failure

chapters.name: Excretory Products and their Elimination
topics: Modes of excretion: ammonotelism, ureotelism, uricotelism
human excretory system: structure and function
regulation of kidney function: renin-angiotensin, atrial natriuretic factor, ADH and diabetes insipidus
role of other organs in excretion
disorders: uremia, renal failure, renal calculi, nephritis

chapters.name: Locomotion and Movement
topics: Types of movement: ciliary, flagellar, muscular
skeletal muscle, contractile proteins and muscle contraction
disorders: myasthenia gravis, tetany, muscular dystrophy, arthritis, osteoporosis, gout

chapters.name: Neural Control and Coordination
topics: central, peripheral and visceral nervous systems in humans
generation and conduction of nerve impulse

chapters.name: Chemical Coordination and Integration
topics: human endocrine system: hypothalamus, pituitary, pineal, thyroid, parathyroid, adrenal, pancreas, gonads
hypo- and hyperactivity and related disorders: dwarfism, acromegaly, cretinism, goitre, exophthalmic goitre, diabetes, Addison's disease

chapters.name: Digestion and Absorption
topics: role of digestive enzymes and gastrointestinal hormones
peristalsis, digestion, absorption and assimilation of proteins, carbohydrates and fats
nutritional and digestive disorders: PEM, indigestion, constipation, vomiting, jaundice, diarrhoea
